subject.title: fix(telegram): DM lane stays dead after a wedged handler keeps it guarded; escalate to a supervised gateway restart

question: Should ChannelAccountSnapshot permanently expose a generic processRestartRequired contract that lets any channel request a gateway-wide restart?
rationale: The mechanism is an additive plugin/channel API and gateway availability policy, so code correctness alone cannot establish whether this should be a reusable public contract or a narrower Telegram-owned seam.

options.title: Approve the generic contract
options.body: Keep the typed snapshot field, but require lifecycle-persistent restart-loop protection, contract documentation, and focused cross-channel tests before merge.

options.title: Keep recovery Telegram-owned
options.body: Replace the generic public field with a narrow injected restart-request seam if maintainers do not want channel snapshots to control gateway-wide recovery.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic contract
recommendation.body: Keep the typed snapshot field, but require lifecycle-persistent restart-loop protection, contract documentation, and focused cross-channel tests before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent ownership signal in the Telegram spool and polling lifecycle that publishes the proposed status field.
